{#
  /llms.txt (llmstxt.org): an H1, a blockquote summary, a little context, then
  H2 sections of links. English and root only; the Dutch site is one line
  under Optional.

  Nothing in it is typed that data/ already says. The current roles are the
  `end: present` ones, the page list is every page with a markdown twin, and
  each page's description is its own meta description. The page links go to
  the twins, because the reason to fetch this file is to read the site without
  its HTML; each page's own URL rides alongside for citing.
#}
{% import "md/_macros.md" as md with context %}
# {{ profile.name }}

> {{ profile.headline }} in {{ profile.location }}. {{ profile.tagline }}

This is {{ profile.name }}'s CV site. Every page and document on it is generated from one set of YAML files on each deploy, so none of them can disagree with another. Each page has a markdown copy at its own URL plus `index.md`, and `llms-full.txt` is the whole CV in one file.

{{ profile.nationality_note }}.{{ ' ' ~ profile.availability.text if profile.availability.show else '' }}

## Current roles

{% for role in current_roles %}
- {{ md.link(role.title ~ ', ' ~ role.company, md.abs('/experience/#' ~ role.id)) }}: {{ role.type }}, {{ role.location }}, since {{ role.start_label }}. {{ role.summary }}
{% endfor %}

## Pages

{% for p in md_pages %}
- {{ md.link(p.nav, md.abs(p.markdown)) }}: {{ p.description }} Markdown copy of <{{ md.abs(p.path) }}>.
{% endfor %}

## Documents

- {{ md.link('llms-full.txt', md.abs('/llms-full.txt')) }}: The whole CV as one markdown file: every role with its highlights and full duty list, then education, courses, skills and contact.
{{ md.documents() }}
## Docs and agents

- {{ md.link('Docs', profile.links.docs) }}: Notes and runbooks, written as they are worked out.
- {{ md.link('Docs llms.txt', profile.links.docs ~ 'llms.txt') }}: The docs site's own map for assistants.
- {{ md.link('MCP server', profile.links.mcp) }}: Public, read-only MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP, no authentication. It searches this site and the docs.
- {{ md.link('MCP server card', profile.links.mcp ~ 'server-card') }}: The server's name, endpoint and protocol versions, readable before connecting.
- {{ md.link('AI catalog', md.abs('/.well-known/ai-catalog.json')) }}: The MCP server listed for agents that discover tools per domain. {{ md.link('API catalog', md.abs('/.well-known/api-catalog')) }} says the same as an RFC 9727 linkset.

## Contact and profiles

- {{ md.link('Email', 'mailto:' ~ profile.contact.email) }}: {{ profile.contact.email }}
- {{ md.link('Phone', 'tel:' ~ profile.contact.phone_href) }}: {{ profile.contact.phone }}
- {{ md.link(t('cta.book_call'), profile.links.booking) }}
- {{ md.link('GitHub', profile.links.github) }}
- {{ md.link('LinkedIn', profile.links.linkedin) }}
- {{ md.link('Credly', profile.links.credly) }}: verifiable certification badges
- {{ md.link('Udemy', profile.links.udemy) }}: course history

## Optional

{% for loc in locales if loc.code != default_locale %}
- {{ md.link(loc.native, md.abs(loc.prefix ~ '/')) }}: The same site translated ({{ loc.html_lang }}), with markdown copies at the same paths under {{ loc.prefix }}/.
{% endfor %}
- {{ md.link('Sitemap', md.abs('/sitemap.xml')) }}: Every page in every language.
- {{ md.link('Source', site.repo) }}: The data files and the build that produce everything above.
